answer: Cheap throwaway accounts lose their bond on detection, while honest participants gain a trustworthy signal from stake-weighted history. Each agent must post a bond into a shared vault before earning reputation; reputation slot keys are bound to a unique cipher that rotates per epoch, so one key cannot spawn many identities. Forging N sybils costs N bonds plus the cipher rotation overhead, making large-scale fakery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
